accuracy: Independent ideal/staged pair eligibility and transition matrices per actual row. Ideal direct metrics are diagnostic; passing class/special gates use staged contract.
binary_encoding: dtype-major f64,f32,flex32,f16,bf16; operation-major log1p,sinh,cosh,tan; sorted unsigned input; five destination-width little-endian words input,ideal,staged,allowed_low,allowed_high then u32 intermediate_f32
chain: Each primitive is materialized/read; lookup uses actual stored input. Mixed recipes execute all three operations when selected by any member. No aggregate-chain error bound.

checks.output_half_nan_intermediate: canonical F32 quiet NaN 7fc00000; input bytes remain exact

normalization: Only expected NaNs and semantic chain NaN lookup are canonicalized. Half NaN intermediate is canonical F32 7fc00000. Input/source bytes remain exact.

accuracy_accounting.forbidden: Never assume ideal_finite_pairs equals finite_pairs or a finite count from an earlier corpus.
accuracy_accounting.half_scan: Exhaustively scan ideal/staged class and nonzero-finite status for each of 65536 inputs and four operations.
accuracy_accounting.maxima: Each histogram, maximum, and worst-input record uses its own eligible-pair denominator.
accuracy_accounting.pair_rule: Derive staged and ideal metric eligibility separately from each actual result row.

finite_metric.meaning: representable-step metric; not a claim about local-spacing real-error ULP

policy.finite_normal_subnormal: Diagnostic within the step or half-image allowance, consistent with frozen Exp/Log v2 and trig.

algorithm: Enumerate rank(c)-b through rank(c)+b using the operation-specific F32 budget.
Retain non-NaN F32 codes, including zeros, subnormals, and infinities.
Convert each code once with exact destination RNE and deduplicate.
Apply exact-special, staged class, sign, nonzero, and codomain gates independently.
half_envelope.exact_specials: singleton expected bits or NaN class; no widening
half_envelope.infinite_center: No finite metric. Staged infinity class remains strict even if finite neighbors enter the image.
half_envelope.limit: Final membership cannot establish the hidden intermediate or emitted schedule.

independent_gates: Shape, dtype, output byte count, exact source bytes, aliases, guards, odd packed tails, and no launches for empty tensors.
NaN versus infinity versus finite versus zero classes match; all expected nonzero outputs remain nonzero.
Every non-NaN output sign matches the reference, including signed zero and overflow infinity.
Log1p domain and minus-one singularity remain strict.
Cosh finite results are positive and at least one; infinity is positive.
Expected finite output cannot become infinity, even within one rank of maximum finite.
Expected overflow infinity cannot become maximum finite, even within one rank.
Exact-special inputs bypass numerical widening. NaN payload/sign/quiet-bit outputs remain observations.

integration.constraints: Reuse the current typed ABI and Native dispatch paths; do not create a duplicate family.
integration.implementation_status: No repository implementation in this cache-only task.
integration.opcodes: Preserve Elementwise discriminants: Log1p17, Sinh30, Cosh31, Tan32.
integration.prerequisite: Compiler full-entry qualification, followed by actual shared conformance.
integration.proposal: Extend existing FloatArithmetic operation list from 19 to 23.

log1p.cubecl_0_11_3: Lowered through polyfill (input + one).ln(); source-level mismatch with tiny/signed-zero target.
log1p.native_f32: Existing compensation log(u)*(x/(u-1)), u=RN32(1+x), returns original bits for u=1 or +Inf.
options: Prefer a qualified genuine typed primitive if the pinned frontend exposes one.
Otherwise qualify a compensated implementation separately for each arithmetic type.
Keep strict specials and evaluate primitive rounding, division, contraction, and FTZ behavior.
log1p.oracle: MPFR log1p on exact stored x; never log(RN(1+x))
log1p.warning: Algebra does not prove an error budget. No inherited CUDA Log1p guarantee covers a composed implementation.

policy.no_ftz: Any expected nonzero-to-zero output fails independently of numerical distance.

options.comparison: independent reference for each actual stored input
options.half: all 65536 stored encodings per dtype and operation
options.math: ordinary typed Tan/Sinh/Cosh; no approximate or fast-math substitution
options.oracle: MPFR 4.2.2 RNDD/RNDU; exact integer RNE; fail unresolved above 8192 bits
options.runtime: future official CLI and actual native GPU qualification required
options.selection: all four operations and all five dtypes
options.wide: fixed bounded boundary, exponent-stratified, pi-derived, and SHA256 input lists

references.f64: RN64(f(exact stored binary64 input)); no public-path F32 narrowing
references.flex32: same values as F32, separate metadata; no TF32 quantization
references.half_schedule: stored half -> exact F32 promotion -> F32 operation -> one destination RNE

policy.status: proposed project targets; no GPU accuracy or backend parity claim

vendor_figures.status: empirical nonexhaustive maxima, not guarantees; no transfer to composed Log1p implementation

reference: Directed MPFR 4.2.2 plus exact rational RNE; no production or host libm expected arithmetic
scope: Forward only; no autodiff, GPU accuracy, Linux parity, or performance claim
selection: --op selects primitive/public operation plus every complete chain containing that operation. --finite retains chains only when every legal closure input and ideal output is finite.
threshold_proofs: Each counts.<dtype>.<operation>.input_boundaries entry retains directed bounds and a twice-precision recheck. Overflow entries distinguish ideal, half-staged, and F32-intermediate thresholds.
unknown_inputs: Unknown finite stored inputs are observed failures. Arbitrary NaN inputs have exact class-special fallback; no finite approximation fallback.
unknown_matrix_accounting: Missing-reference observations occupy the NaN row in both matrices for total bookkeeping only, with separate unreferenced_observed_classes. They always fail and have no finite-pair metric.
